description: This file serves as the server entry point for a Remix-based web application. It handles incoming HTTP requests, including CORS preflight checks, and uses React's server-side rendering capabilities to stream React components to the client. It distinguishes between bot and browser requests for optimized rendering workflows, utilizing 'react-dom/server' for streaming responses.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main handler function for incoming requests; manages CORS headers, OPTIONS requests, and delegates the request processing based on whether the client is a bot or a browser.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles rendering responses for bot requests, streaming the server-rendered React component with special handling for rendering errors.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles rendering responses for browser requests, similarly streaming the React component and managing errors during server-side rendering.
